# sherpa-router

The ONE owner of the URL, on the Navigation API. It draws nothing.

|  |  |
|---|---|
| Source | [.ts](../../src/components/sherpa-router/sherpa-router.ts) · [.html](../../src/components/sherpa-router/sherpa-router.html) · [.css](../../src/components/sherpa-router/sherpa-router.css) · [.component.json](../../src/components/sherpa-router/sherpa-router.component.json) · [.example.json](../../src/components/sherpa-router/sherpa-router.example.json) |

## When to use it

One per page owns the URL: `data-params` lists the parameters it owns, and `data-overlay` the ones that open over the page. To navigate, write a real `<a href>` (`href()` builds one) or call `go()`; nothing else calls `history.pushState`.

## Example

```html
<sherpa-router data-params="context=home view" data-overlay="settings"></sherpa-router><a href="?context=records">Records</a>
```

## Attributes

| Attribute | Values | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|
| `data-overlay` | text |  | owned parameters that open OVER the page. A link that names only these keeps the rest of the route as it is |
| `data-params` | text |  | the URL search parameters it owns, space separated: `name`, or `name=default` for the value a URL that leaves it out means |

## Properties

| Property | Type | Access | What it is |
|---|---|---|---|
| `route` | `Route` | read only |  |

## Methods

| Method | What it does |
|---|---|
| `href(route: Route)` | The URL for a route — for a real `<a href>`. Unowned parameters are kept. |
| `go(changes: Route, options: { replace?: boolean } = {})` | Navigate: the changes over the route now. Settles when the page has. |

## Events

Each one bubbles.

| Event | Detail |
|---|---|
| `route-change` | `{ changed: string[]; previous: Route; route: Route; type: 'push' \| 'replace' \| 'traverse'; waitUntil: (work: Promise<unknown>) => undefined }` |

## Slots

| Slot | Accepts | What it holds |
|---|---|---|
| (default) | content | whatever it is wrapped round, drawn as if it were not there |

## populate()

`{ overlay?, params? }`

Its declared props by name: `label` sets data-label.
